title: The Portrait of Little Hawley
author: Yara Thornbury
blurb: Zephyrine Okafor, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
